record.context_brief: simplicial models for tangent-cone Betti numbers
record.original_question: Let Gamma be a numerical semigroup, let R_Gamma = k[[Gamma]] be its local semigroup ring, and let G_Gamma = gr(R_Gamma) be its associated graded ring. Is there a way to compute the Betti numbers b_i(G_Gamma) or the graded Betti numbers b_{i,j}(G_Gamma) by taking homology of simplicial complexes naturally attached to Gamma?

evidence.quote: Problem 1. Let Γ be a numerical semigroup. Is it possible to compute the Betti numbers bi(GΓ ) or bi,j(GΓ ) via homology of appropriate simplicial complexes?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $\Gamma \subseteq \mathbb{N}$ be a numerical semigroup, that is, a cofinite submonoid of $(\mathbb{N},+)$ containing $0$. Fix a field $k$ and consider the local semigroup ring
$$R_\Gamma = k[[\Gamma]] = k[[t^\gamma : \gamma \in \Gamma]] \subseteq k[[t]],$$
together with its associated graded ring with respect to the maximal ideal $\mathfrak{m} = (t^\gamma : \gamma \in \Gamma\setminus\{0\})$,
$$G_\Gamma = \mathrm{gr}_{\mathfrak{m}}(R_\Gamma) = \bigoplus_{n\geq 0} \mathfrak{m}^n/\mathfrak{m}^{n+1}.$$
Let $b_i(G_\Gamma) = \dim_k \mathrm{Tor}_i^{G_\Gamma}(k,k)$ denote the (total) Betti numbers of $G_\Gamma$ as a graded module over an appropriate polynomial ring presenting it, and let $b_{i,j}(G_\Gamma)$ denote the corresponding graded Betti numbers.

Question: Does there exist a family of simplicial complexes $\Delta_i(\Gamma)$ (or $\Delta_{i,j}(\Gamma)$) constructed combinatorially from $\Gamma$ such that the Betti numbers $b_i(G_\Gamma)$ (respectively the graded Betti numbers $b_{i,j}(G_\Gamma)$) can be computed as dimensions of reduced simplicial homology groups of these complexes?
artifact.status_search_result: While Betti numbers of the semigroup ring $R_\Gamma$ itself are known to be computable via squarefree divisor complexes (a theorem due to Campillo–Marijuán and Bresinsky–Li), no analogous general simplicial-complex description for the Betti numbers of the associated graded ring $G_\Gamma$ appears in the literature. Existing work treats only special families (e.g., 4-generated pseudo-symmetric, certain Cohen–Macaulay tangent cones, shifted/homogeneous semigroups). The general question of a simplicial model for $b_i(G_\Gamma)$ or $b_{i,j}(G_\Gamma)$ is stated as an open problem and the searches do not show a resolution.

status_evidence.title: Betti Numbers for Numerical Semigroup Rings
status_evidence.snippet: Survey of Betti numbers of semigroup rings via squarefree divisor complexes; analogous formulas for tangent cones discussed only in special cases.
status_evidence.claim: General simplicial-complex computation of Betti numbers of G_Gamma is not established.

status_evidence.title: Betti numbers for certain Cohen–Macaulay tangent cones
status_evidence.snippet: Computes Betti numbers of tangent cones for specific families of numerical semigroups.
status_evidence.claim: Only partial/special-case results are available for Betti numbers of tangent cones.
